name: Jira - shipped but not localized (INTERNAT)
description: Weekday check for INTERNAT localization tickets whose linked product ticket is already Done. Posts only the delta to #i18n-team.

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = INTERNAT AND (statusCategory != Done OR status = "PROD VERIFICATION") ORDER BY key ASC

parameters.content:
## Shipped but not localized

JQL cannot filter on a linked issue status, so this pulls every open INTERNAT ticket with its issuelinks field (which carries the linked issue status inline) and filters in code.

Gotchas: the link type is named "Localization ticket " WITH A TRAILING SPACE, matched with indexOf. The product ticket is always the inward issue seen from the INTERNAT side.

Only the delta is posted. State lives in workflow static data, which persists across scheduled runs but not manual test runs.
